enable_generator.description: Kill switch for the contract generator (Dashboard > Create Contract).

enable_llm.description: Kill switch for the on-device LLM explanation. When false, the TFLite classifier with rule-based explanations is used.

defaultValue.value: A classification is shown only when LegalEase is at least 80% confident.

confidence_threshold_text.description: Text shown next to the confidence band. Display only: it does not change the 0.80 threshold.
